{
  "Select": [
    "assays.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id",
    "target_dictionary.target_type AS target_type",
    "target_dictionary.tax_id AS tax_id",
    "compound_structures.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles",
    "molecule_dictionary.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id",
    "activities.standard_type AS standard_type",
    "activities.pchembl_value AS pchembl_value"
  ],
  "Source": [
    "activities",
    "assays",
    "molecule_dictionary",
    "compound_structures",
    "target_dictionary"
  ],
  "Join": [
    "activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id",
    "activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno",
    "molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno",
    "activities.toid = target_dictionary.tid"
  ],
  "Filter": [
    "activities.type = 'IC50'",
    "activities.standard_relation = '='",
    "activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL",
    "target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293255'",
    "target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'",
    "target_dictionary.tax_id = 9606"
  ],
  "Sort": [
    "molecule_chembl_id ASC",
    "assay_chembl_id ASC"
  ],
  "Limit": 1000
}
